report.summary: Analyzed daedalus/providers/codex_cli.py chunk 1 of 1: CodexCLIProvider class, build_prompt function, constants, and claims.
risks: handoff.notes | medium | handoff object only has notes field, losing structured handoff data | confirm if callers handle truncated handoff
stdin=DEVNULL | medium | codex may hang if stdin not closed; fix applied via DEVNULL | verify codex version behavior
encoding utf-8 errors replace | medium | Windows cp1252 issues fixed; replace mode may mangle data | test on Windows with non-ASCII chars
disk_may_be_dirty flag | high | codex killed mid-write may leave partial edits; caller must handle dirty state | verify caller checks risks
codex exec --output-schema strict schema | medium | handoff.notes string may truncate complex data | ensure callers serialize to notes

handoff.purpose: OpenAI Codex CLI provider: external write-capable lane with egress gating

symbols.name: REPORT_SCHEMA
symbols.note: JSON Schema for codex --output-schema; mirrors REPORT_KEYS but handoff is object with only notes string

symbols.name: build_prompt
symbols.note: Builds prompt for codex exec; includes action constraints, denied path fragments, and output format specification

symbols.name: CodexCLIProvider
symbols.note: Provider class for Codex CLI; caps: can_write=True, local=False, trusted_with_ip=False, agentic=True

symbols.name: CodexCLIProvider.available
symbols.note: Returns True if 'codex' is on PATH

symbols.name: CodexCLIProvider.run
symbols.note: Main entry: egress gate via classify_data, spawns codex exec, parses report, returns provider-wrapped result

claims.text: codex exec runs the Codex agent non-interactively against a target repo: it reads the repo itself and edits files IN PLACE
claims.why: CodexCLIProvider.run spawns 'codex exec' with --sandbox workspace-write (when writable=True) and --cd repo_root; no context injection or draft-apply step.

claims.text: the offload seam's existing disk-changed verifier semantics apply to its results -- this provider adds no parallel verification mechanism.
claims.why: No code in this chunk implements or references a disk-changed verifier; the claim refers to external infrastructure.

claims.text: Codex is an EXTERNAL API -- bytes leave the machine to OpenAI. It is therefore NOT trusted with proprietary IP, and every task is gated through the same per-project egress policy as DeepSeek (daedalus.sensitivity.classify_data, fail-closed default-deny) BEFORE the CLI is ever spawned. A denied path never reaches codex.
claims.why: In run(), classify_data(paths, extra_text=objective, policy=policy) is called first; if verdict.sensitive, returns blocked_report without spawning codex.

claims.text: The gate refuses tasks whose declared paths/objective are sensitive, and the prompt instructs codex to keep out of policy-denied trees, but only the pre-dispatch refusal is a hard guarantee.
claims.why: Pre-dispatch refusal is implemented; prompt includes denied path fragments (deny_substrings) as instructions, but codex is agentic and may ignore them.

claims.text: --sandbox workspace-write   write mode; read-only for advisory
claims.why: In run(), cmd includes '--sandbox', 'workspace-write' if writable else 'read-only'.

claims.text: --skip-git-repo-check       target repos are not always git repos
--output-schema <FILE>      JSON Schema for the final response shape
--color never               no ANSI noise in captured output

claims.why: cmd adds '--model', chosen_model only if chosen_model is non-empty.

claims.text: codex exec is the documented non-interactive mode; it never prompts for approval, so no approval flag is needed (--ask-for-approval is only documented for the interactive CLI). Auth comes from codex login (run by the operator); this provider never triggers a login flow.
claims.why: The code does not include any approval flag or login flow; it relies on 'codex exec' being non-interactive and pre-existing auth.

claims.text: OpenAI structured-output strict mode (which backs codex --output-schema) rejects any object without additionalProperties: false and with non-required properties (400 invalid_json_schema, live-fired 2026-07-11 task C2). A free-form object is therefore not expressible; carry free-form handoff content in a single notes string instead.
claims.why: REPORT_SCHEMA defines handoff as object with only notes string, required, additionalProperties false.

claims.text: npm installs codex as a .CMD shim on Windows; subprocess cannot spawn it by bare name (WinError 2), so resolve the real path.
claims.why: codex = shutil.which('codex') or 'codex' resolves the full path to the executable.

claims.text: codex emits UTF-8 (em-dashes, box-drawing chars); WITHOUT an explicit encoding, text=True decodes with the Windows locale (cp1252) and the capture reader-thread dies on bytes like 0x9d -> corrupted/empty output, watcher thread crash (live-fired 2026-07-12, tasks C2/C3). Force UTF-8 and never let a stray byte kill the reader.
claims.why: subprocess.run is called with encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'.

claims.text: stdin MUST be closed: with a prompt arg, codex exec still appends piped/inherited stdin as a <stdin> block and blocks until EOF. Under the file-bridge watcher the inherited stdin never closes -> codex hangs at ~0 CPU (live-fired 2026-07-11, task C1).
Measured live 2026-07-11: real repo tasks (C1/C2) take 8-20 min in codex exec; 300s killed C2's wrapper while codex kept working and the report went out as blocked despite good disk changes.
claims.why: timeout_s defaults to 1500 (25 minutes), longer than 300s.

claims.text: Egress-gated exactly like DeepSeek (trusted_with_ip=False): a task with policy-denied paths/content is refused before any subprocess is spawned.
claims.why: caps.trusted_with_ip is False; run() calls classify_data first and returns blocked_report if sensitive.

observations.what: REPORT_SCHEMA handoff object only has required 'notes' string; structured handoff data (module, chunk, purpose, symbols, claims, observations) is lost if caller expects full handoff.
stdin=DEVNULL is set to prevent hang; this is a critical fix documented from live fire.
encoding='utf-8', errors='replace' prevents reader crash on Windows; replace may silently corrupt characters.
disk_may_be_dirty flag is set in blocked_report when writable=True and codex times out or exits non-zero; caller must handle dirty state.
The prompt includes denied path fragments from policy.deny_substrings, but codex is agentic and may ignore them; only pre-dispatch refusal is guaranteed.
RUN_DIR/last_codex_prompt.md and RUN_DIR/last_codex_report.json are written for debugging; failures are silently ignored.
